fieldData.main-content:
We have completed the consultation to define the assets that represent valid voting power in Radix Consultation Snapshots.

As we transition to the community-led model, clarity is essential. There cannot have ambiguity about who has a voice in consultations. We asked you to input which assets should count, setting a threshold of 60% acceptance for inclusion.

With over 1.4 Billion XRD participating from 743 accounts, the community has drawn a clear line.

The Results

The community voted to INCLUDE the following assets (meeting the 60% threshold):

  • XRD Staked on Top 100 Validators: 79% Support
  • XRD Staked on Any Validator: 69% Support
  • Liquid XRD held in Accounts: 69% Support
  • XRD in Supported DEX Pools*: 60% Support

‍

*These will be the pools supported in Radix Rewards S1 for now.

The community voted to EXCLUDE the following assets (failing the threshold):

  • Time-Locked XRD: 44% Support
  • Lent XRD: 28% Support

‍

The New Standard

Future governance snapshots and consultations will calculate voting weight based on the aggregate sum of:

  1. Staked XRD (All validators)
  2. Liquid XRD
  3. XRD/LSUs in supported DEX Pools

We will update the community when necessary changes to consultation.radixdlt.com have been made so snapshots reflect this new standard. 

Thank you to the 743 participants who participated.
fieldData.name: Consultation Results: Defining Eligible Assets for Snapshots
